manifest.name: SYNTHETIC acceptance model

assumptions.cash_interest: closing cash times annual cash_rate / 252, once per observed trading day
assumptions.corporate_actions: no corporate-action cash flows; adjusted prices not double counted; raw_cash unsupported
assumptions.coverage: observed dates match supplied expected_trading_days for requested interval
assumptions.drawdown_pause: sticky for remaining period; attempts liquidation subject to settlement and participation
assumptions.execution: next available real bar open after completed signal; no order-book or queue simulation

assumptions.participation: previous completed signal-bar volume; remainder expires at next eligible open
assumptions.performance: daily closing equity returns, 252 trading days/year; intraday drawdown reported separately
assumptions.tradability: positive valid OHLC bars assumed tradable; no inferred suspensions or limit states
